title: VELOCITY

lists.name: Text
items: SURGE VELOCITY = 1,500 meters per year = 4 meters per day = 50 microns (500,000 angstroms) per second

Titanic strain bulges the face of Trapridge Glacier [Yukon] as interior ice presses downhill at the beginning of a surge. Glaciologists monitor the event with electric thermometers set in a grid seen on the glacier's foot.

notes: A photographed glacier image with a velocity calculation and explanatory caption; small handwritten annotations are unreadable.
